name: @andrueandersoncs/lint-anything
description: Check anything against plain-English policies, judged by Cloudflare's Clef decision model
author: Andrue Anderson

scripts.build: bun build index.ts --target=bun --minify --outfile dist/cli.js && bun build score.ts --target=bun --minify --outfile skills/lint-anything/scripts/score.js && bun build src/lib.ts --target=bun --external effect --external 'effect/*' --outfile dist/lib.js && rm -rf dist/types && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
